name: Runebound Loot
summary: Weapon-only loot affix augmentation for Barony, with per-instance metadata and multiplayer metadata.
description: Runebound Loot augments Barony's item-drop system through BaronyModLoader's engine-owned capabilities. This package adds weapon-prefix and weapon-suffix affixes to generated drops, with per-instance metadata survival across save boundaries and host-authoritative multiplayer metadata. Live gameplay behavior is NOT yet verified. Without a verified installed-executable BML hook runtime this package must fail closed. Current evidence covers only data-file self-test scaffolding and manifest schema acceptance; no installed-executable hook path is implemented for this package. Do not advertise playable support until live gameplay verification passes with a paired installed-executable hook runtime and runtime report evidence.

barony.notes: Runebound Loot is packaged as a clean BML data-driven gameplay mod. Stock Barony cannot load the BML-owned dynamic data files (content/data/bml/*) as standalone behavior. Live gameplay is not yet supported; the unsupported runtime must fail closed. Self-test scaffolding and manifest acceptance are the current verified evidence surface only.

capabilities.reason: Affix roll results must survive the item through saves, deaths, and victory without corrupting base item state.
Runtime must provide reproducible affix roll execution when a generated weapon is dropped or identified.
Affix names must be appended to item names and shown in tooltips by engine-owned rendering.
Engine must persist affix metadata alongside item fields at every safe save boundary.
Affix stat bonuses must be applied to weapon damage/combat calculations by engine-owned damage hooks.
Hosts and clients must agree on active Runebound Loot package, runtime contract, and loot data schema before interacting with shared loot state.

lootAffixes.description: Host-authoritative weapon-only affix augmentation. Metadata is scoped to the current save. Multiplayer must reject clients that lack matching package and runtime metadata before any gameplay interaction. No live gameplay path is implemented yet; this module fails closed without a verified installed-executable BML hook runtime.

native.notes: This MVP is data-only. No native hook runtime is declared. The modules.lootAffixes declaration provides a manifest contract that a future installed-executable hook runtime must satisfy. Self-test scaffolding validates the manifest and data files only.

conflicts.reason: Runebound Loot claims authoritative weapon-affix augmentation. Another mod that owns the same capability could corrupt or fork per-instance affix metadata.

checksums.notes: Checksums are generated at install time for release packages. Development packages may omit this field.

source.transparency: No source-built Barony binary is claimed by this package. This package ships data and manifest only. Live gameplay requires a future paired installed-executable hook runtime.

build.notes: No build step. This package is data and manifest only. Live gameplay requires a future paired installed-executable hook runtime.

runtimeReports.notes: Runtime report expectations reflect manifest-level declarations only. No installed-executable hook runtime is present. Without that runtime, blockOnErrors causes profile activation to fail closed. Self-test scaffolding can exercise manifest + data-file validation independently of gameplay hooks.
